title: A Inventory for the Wardrobe
author: Felix Pemberton
blurb: Ivo Brightwater, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, has spent ten years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must return to the place where the story went wrong before the demolition date arrives.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
